question: A parallelogram has sides of 22 cm and 16 cm. The angle between them is 45^circ. Find the exact area of the parallelogram and the height corresponding to the longer side.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Area of Parallelogram = Side₁ × Side₂ × sin(θ)

Area = 22 × 16 × sin(45°) = 352 × (1/√2) = 176√2 cm²

Height (h) = Area ÷ Base = 176√2 ÷ 22 = 8√2 cm

**∴ Answer = 176√2 cm², 8√2 cm**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sides of the parallelogram: a = 22 cm, b = 16 cm

Angle between the sides: θ = 45°

**Formula used:**

Area = Side₁ × Side₂ × sin(θ)

Area = Base × Height

 
 
• 
 45° Base (a) = 22 cm Side (b) = 16 cm h Area = 176√2 cm² 

**Calculations:**

Area = 22 × 16 × sin(45°)

⇒ Area = 352 × (1/√2)

⇒ Area = (352 ÷ √2) × (√2 ÷ √2) = 176√2 cm²

⇒ Height corresponding to the longer side (h) × 22 = 176√2

⇒ h = 176√2 ÷ 22 = 8√2 cm

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
